_comment: Application config. The values in the first block are the material the device signature is derived from and the identity every login request carries, so they have to match the build they are paired with. Nothing here is a secret: appid/appkey are identifiers, not credentials, and the original ships them in plain sight (out/main-renderer/renderer.js getInitData).
_comment_oauth: Account-centre OAuth2 tenant. The login client uses this pair for the device-code scan flow and the session->token exchange; the original carries it in getInitUserLoginParam.
_comment_engine: Download engine. Leave aria2Path out and the app looks for bin/aria2c(.exe), then vendor/aria2/, then <resources>/bin/. With none of those present it falls back to a stub engine so the app still starts. downloadDir defaults to ~/ThunderX.
_comment_endpoints: Override only when pointing at a test environment.
_comment_suspension: The floating ball. showSuspension=false keeps it hidden. The suspension block is only the starting position: null x/y means 'bottom-right, as the original ships it'. The spot the user drags the ball to is runtime state and is saved to the user-data directory, not written back here.
